author: Dyspa
body:
Hey all o/
I'm glad to announce I'll be making an optifine cape giveaway because, why not?
All you need to do is post your IGN and somewhere to contact you in the comment section.
With that said, I wish you good luck! Giveaway ends the 22th of May.
Cheers, Juan.



(I'll choose the winner in this website: http://www.alazar.info/generador-de-sorteos)
